exceptions.justification: CodeRabbit reviews pull requests as a GitHub App; its CLI is not run inside the CI contract job.
exceptions.ruleBroken: CodeRabbit findings must be addressed or recorded before merge.
exceptions.attempted: Running the CodeRabbit CLI in the workflow, which needs a CodeRabbit API key that is not issued to CI.
exceptions.constraint: In CI the review is the GitHub App's; the CLI only reviews uncommitted local edits.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The App's review threads are resolved on the pull request before merge, so its findings still block.
exceptions.residualRisk: A finding the App never raised is not seen; the same is true of any reviewer.
exceptions.revisitWhen: CodeRabbit ships a CI mode for the CLI, or the App is uninstalled.

exceptions.justification: The flow-explorer example is added by this change, so https://github.com/MaverickCER/data-cap/tree/main/examples/flow-explorer returns 404 until the change is merged to main.
exceptions.attempted: Checked that examples/flow-explorer exists on this branch and is linked from examples/README.md and the guide.
exceptions.constraint: The link names the main branch on GitHub, which only has the directory after the merge.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The alternative is to omit the link to the example from the docs until after the merge, which would leave the new feature undiscoverable in the same release.
exceptions.residualRisk: If the example is never merged, the link stays broken; the next DocsLinks run after the merge would report it.
exceptions.revisitWhen: The change is merged to main; remove this record then.
